THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
144
STUDY 154
Black Strapless Top & Grommet Mini
Rights check
Source: 25031.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight dark brown
hair wears a black strapless fitted top with a crossed
black strap around the neck. A black leather mini skirt
with rows of silver grommets and buckle straps sits low
at the hip, with long black fingerless gloves on both
arms. Tall black lace-up platform boots with buckle
straps complete the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. A soft pastel gradient backdrop with even light.
Palette of black, silver, and pastel mint and butter
yellow. Bold and sleek, in the style of a Y2K fashion
catalog.
Bold, sleek, edgy
WORKING NOTES
- The grommeted mini and platform boots are the defining
elements.
- Keep the pastel gradient for a soft contrast behind the
black outfit.
Try this: Keep the pastel gradient behind the black outfit.
